site: Middle Fork Willamette River near Dexter, Oregon
terrain: OLC Middle Fork Willamette 2015 topobathymetric lidar (NOAA 9170); document interpolation and map section placement
event_selection: First published direct discharge measurement with gage height after 2015-09-15 for this station. Freeze the observation original before hydraulic calculation. Only use paired discharge and stage; document availability and datum.
station: At the public gage, within the reach, never a stage boundary
threshold_basis: Predeclared software-pilot investigation threshold only. Report signed modeled minus observed stage; record missing gage uncertainty and datum evidence.

initial_roughness.basis: conditional screening assumptions; fixed before the event is compared

revision: Introduce withheld observed stage as supplemental evidence and recalculate or regenerate the appropriate edition. Keep the hydraulic inputs fixed. Exclude observed stage from boundary assignment, slope derivation and roughness tuning.
acceptance: Homepage through input confirmation, real native results, supplemental evidence, selected revised edition and both verified mapped packages; record automated UI clicks, repeated form entries and manual project JSON edits. Preserve conditional verdicts and original files.
